F.E. DuBose Campus in Manning
Aerial photo: USDA National Agriculture Imagery Program (2023), via USFS and GeoPlatform

Source & image record ↗ · Public domain · USDA aerial photography

Vernon Tanner of the Chaloklowa Chickasaw Indian People spoke about Indigenous participation in the American Revolution at the October 2006 Francis Marion Symposium. This 2023 aerial photograph shows the Central Carolina Technical College campus that hosted the symposium. The image is resized for the web and retains the listed license.

Context and identification sources
